
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/19554323" title="发布于 2026-01-30 16:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">主定理学习笔记</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>主定理（Master Theorem）是用于分析分治算法复杂度的重要定理。</p>
<h2 id="前置知识">前置知识</h2>
<h3 id="渐进符号的概念">渐进符号的概念</h3>
<h4 id="1-紧确渐进界">1. <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Theta}\)</span>（紧确渐进界）</h4>
<p>若存在正常数 <span class="math inline">\(c_1,c_2,n_0\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(\forall n\ge n_0\)</span> 都有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[0\le c_1\cdot g(n)\le f(n)\le c_2\cdot g(n)
\]</div><p></p><p>则记 <span class="math inline">\(f(n)=\mathcal{\Theta}(g(n))\)</span>。<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Theta}\)</span> 是等价关系，表示 <span class="math inline">\(f,g\)</span> 增长速度同阶，类似 <span class="math inline">\(=\)</span>。</p>
<h4 id="2-渐进上界">2. <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}\)</span>（渐进上界）</h4>
<p>若存在正常数 <span class="math inline">\(c,n_0\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(\forall n\ge n_0\)</span> 都有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[0\le f(n)\le c\cdot g(n)
\]</div><p></p><p>则记 <span class="math inline">\(f(n)=\mathcal{O}(g(n))\)</span>。<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}\)</span> 是拟序关系，类似 <span class="math inline">\(\le\)</span>（小于等于）。</p>
<h4 id="3-渐进下界">3. <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Omega}\)</span>（渐进下界）</h4>
<p>若存在正常数 <span class="math inline">\(c,n_0\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(\forall n\ge n_0\)</span> 都有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[0\le c\cdot g(n)\le f(n)
\]</div><p></p><p>则记 <span class="math inline">\(f(n)=\mathcal{\Omega}(g(n))\)</span>。<span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Omega}\)</span> 也是拟序关系，类似 <span class="math inline">\(\ge\)</span>（大于等于）。</p>
<p>三者如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://oi-wiki.org/basic/images/order.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="常用性质">常用性质</h3>
<ol>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(n)=\mathcal{\Theta}(g(n))\Leftrightarrow f(n)=\mathcal{O}(g(n)) \land f(n)=\mathcal{\Omega}(g(n))\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(n)=\mathcal{\Theta}(f(n))\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(c\cdot \mathcal{\Theta}(f(n))=\mathcal{\Theta}(f(n))\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(c&gt;0\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(c\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 无关）</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Theta}(f(n))+\mathcal{\Theta}(g(n))=\mathcal{\Theta}(f(n)+g(n))=\mathcal{\Theta}(\max(f(n),g(n)))\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Theta}(f(n))\mathcal{\Theta}(g(n))=\mathcal{\Theta}(f(n)g(n))\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Theta}(\log_b n)=\mathcal{\Theta}(\log_2 n)\)</span>（<span class="math inline">\(b&gt;1\)</span>）</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>性质 2~6 同样适用于 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{\Omega}\)</span></strong>。</p>
<p>这些性质会在后面的证明中用到。</p>
<h2 id="主定理简化版">主定理简化版</h2>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(T\left(n\right)\)</span> 为分治算法处理规模为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 的问题的复杂度，且满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[T\left(n\right)=
\begin{cases}
aT\left(\frac{n}{b}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\right) &amp; \text{if}\;n\ge b\\
\mathcal{O}\left(1\right) &amp; \text{if}\;n&lt;b
\end{cases}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(a\)</span>：子问题个数（<span class="math inline">\(a\in \mathbb{Z},a\ge 1\)</span>）。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\frac{n}{b}\)</span>：每个子问题大小（<span class="math inline">\(b\in \mathbb{R},b&gt;1\)</span>）。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\right)\)</span>：合并子问题的解得到原问题解的额外复杂度（<span class="math inline">\(d\ge 0\)</span>）。</li>
</ul>
<p>则有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[T\left(n\right)=\begin{cases}
\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_b a}\right) &amp; \text{if} \; d&lt;\log_b a \\
\mathcal{O}\left(n^d \log n\right) &amp; \text{if} \; d=\log_b a \\
\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\right) &amp; \text{if} \; d&gt;\log_b a
\end{cases}
\]</div><p></p><p>这对于 OI 来说已经够用了。</p>
<h3 id="例子">例子</h3>
<ul>
<li>对于归并排序，<span class="math inline">\(a=2,b=2,d=1\)</span>，有 <span class="math inline">\(d=\log_ba\)</span>，因此时间复杂度为 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span>。</li>
<li>对于 <span class="math inline">\(a=2,b=2,d=2\)</span> 的完全二叉树上背包问题，有 <span class="math inline">\(d&gt;\log_ba\)</span>，因此时间复杂度为 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="证明">证明</h3>
<p>不失一般性地，假设 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 的整数次幂。</p>
<p>考虑递归树。若根节点算一层，则树高为 <span class="math inline">\(\log_b n+1\)</span>。单独计算叶子节点，展开得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
T\left(n\right)&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(a^{\log_bn}\right)+\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}a^k\cdot \mathcal{O}\left(\left(\frac{n}{b^k}\right)^d\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(a^{\log_bn}\right)+\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}\mathcal{O}\left(a^k\right)\cdot \mathcal{O}\left(\left(\frac{n}{b^k}\right)^d\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}\mathcal{O}\left(a^k\cdot \frac{n^d}{\left(b^d\right)^k}\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}\mathcal{O}\left(\left(\frac{a}{b^d}\right)^k\cdot n^d\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}\left(\frac{a}{b^d}\right)^k\cdot n^d\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}\left(\frac{a}{b^d}\right)^k\right)\\
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>设 <span class="math inline">\(p=\frac{a}{b^d}\)</span>，则：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{cases}
p&gt;1 &amp; \text{if} \; d&lt;\log_ba \\
p=1 &amp; \text{if} \; d=\log_ba \\
0&lt;p&lt;1 &amp; \text{if} \; d&gt;\log_ba  \\
\end{cases}
\]</div><p></p><p>且</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[T\left(n\right)=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot\sum_{k=0}^{\log_b n-1}p^k\right)
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="情况-1">情况 1（<span class="math inline">\(d&lt;\log_ba\)</span>）</h4>
<p>此时 <span class="math inline">\(p&gt;1\)</span>。</p>
<p>由等比数列求和公式，得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
T\left(n\right)&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \frac{p^{\log_bn}-1}{p-1}\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \left(p^{\log_bn}-1\right)\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \left(\left(\frac{a}{b^d}\right)^{\log_bn}-1\right)\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \left(\frac{a^{\log_bn}}{b^{d\log_bn}}-1\right)\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot\left(\frac{n^{\log_b a}}{n^d}-1\right)\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_b a}-n^d\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="情况-2">情况 2（<span class="math inline">\(d=\log_ba\)</span>）</h4>
<p>此时 <span class="math inline">\(p=1\)</span>。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
T\left(n\right)&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \log_bn\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\log n\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\log n\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><h4 id="情况-3">情况 3（<span class="math inline">\(d&gt;\log_ba\)</span>）</h4>
<p>此时 <span class="math inline">\(0&lt;p&lt;1\)</span>。</p>
<p>由等比数列求和公式，得：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
T\left(n\right)&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \frac{p^{\log_bn}-1}{p-1}\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\cdot \frac{1-p^{\log_bn}}{1-p}\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^{\log_ba}\right)+\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\right)\cdot \mathcal{O}\left(1\right)\\
&amp;=\mathcal{O}\left(n^d\right)
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>注意 <span class="math inline">\(p-1&lt;0\)</span>，故应将分母化为 <span class="math inline">\(1-p\)</span>。</p>
<p>证毕。</p>
<h2 id="主定理完整版">主定理完整版</h2>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(n^d)\)</span> 被换成了更一般的 <span class="math inline">\(f(n)\)</span>。</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[T(n)=aT(\frac{n}{b})+f(n)\quad(n\ge b)
\]</div><p></p><p>则有：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[T(n)=\begin{cases}
\Theta(n^{\log_b a}) &amp; \text{if}\;f(n)=O(n^{\log_b a-\epsilon})\\
\Theta(f(n)) &amp; \text{if}\;f(n)=\Omega(n^{\log_b a+\epsilon})\\
\Theta(n^{\log_b a}\log^{k+1}n) &amp; \text{if}\;f(n)=\Theta(n^{\log_b a}\log^k n)
\end{cases}
\]</div><p></p><p>其中 <span class="math inline">\(\epsilon&gt;0,k\ge 0\)</span>。</p>
<p>注意其中第二条还必须满足存在正常数 <span class="math inline">\(c&lt;1,n_0\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(\forall n\ge n_0\)</span> 都有 <span class="math inline">\(a f(\frac{n}{b}) \le c f(n)\)</span>。</p>
<p>证明比较繁琐，这里不作展开。思路大致就是代入关于 <span class="math inline">\(f(n)\)</span> 的渐进符号然后化简。</p>


</div>
